# High Noon Product

> High Noon Product is an embedded product leadership consultancy based in Lehi, Utah — what many companies search for as "fractional product leadership," delivered with a deeper, long-term commitment. We embed as senior product leaders inside technology companies — handling product vision, product management, and go-to-market strategy from early-stage startups through Fortune 500 enterprises.

We are not a generalist consulting firm. We do the work: market research, roadmap ownership, Agile delivery, positioning, sales enablement, and GTM execution. We stay until the outcomes are real.

## Founder

Trevor Spencer — Founder and Product Leader. Over a decade of product leadership across software, AI, hardware, media, and government technology. Past work includes Okta, Meta, and VivSoft Technologies (DoD Priority 1 contractor).

- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/trevor-spencer/)
- [X / Twitter](https://x.com/metatrev89)

## Services

- **Product Vision** — Competitive analysis, consumer segmentation, market trend research, and a data-backed product roadmap. We tell you what to build and why, before anyone builds anything.
- **Product Management** — Embedded Agile delivery, roadmap prioritization, stakeholder alignment, and cross-functional execution. Day 0 through Day 2.
- **Product Marketing** — Go-to-market strategy, persona development, positioning, messaging, launch plans, sales enablement, and demand generation.

## Who We Work With

1. **Startups (Pre-revenue – $10M)** — Founders who need embedded product leadership from vision through launch.
2. **Small Business ($10M – $100M)** — Companies with revenue but no formal product function; need process, market research, and GTM structure.
3. **Mid-Market ($100M – $1B)** — Established teams where growth is slowing and the roadmap has become reactive; need outside perspective and sharper execution.
4. **Enterprise ($1B+)** — Fortune 500s and government technology programs that need independent product discovery and advisory at scale.

## Blog Posts

- [Lift and Shift: A Leadership Vision for the Intelligence Age](https://www.highnoonproduct.com/posts/lift-and-shift-ai-leadership-vision.html): Every AI CEO gets asked what happens to people's jobs. The answer needs a name and a vision. Here's Economic Self-Actualization: the Lift, the Shift, and the Floor.
- [Called, Chosen, and Aligned: The Faith Behind How We Build Products and Teams](https://www.highnoonproduct.com/posts/called-chosen-and-aligned.html): High Noon Product exists to lead this generation toward the eighth seal. Here's what that calling means, and how it shapes both the products we build and the way we lead the people who build them.
- [Ideation in Product Creation: Permission to Pursue "Stupid" Ideas](https://www.highnoonproduct.com/posts/permission-to-pursue-stupid-ideas.html): The riskiest moment in product creation is the ideation stage, where an inner critic kills ideas by calling them stupid. Here's why to write them down anyway.
- [What Embedded Product Leadership Really Means (and How It Differs From Fractional)](https://www.highnoonproduct.com/posts/embedded-vs-fractional-product-leadership.html): A fractional product manager works part-time; embedded product leadership means owning strategy and execution through the product lifecycle. Here's what each model really means and how to tell which one your product deserves.
- [MetaMind: Why a Product Consultancy](https://www.highnoonproduct.com/posts/metamind-why-a-product-consultancy.html): In a world where anyone can build software with AI, why choose to build a product management business as a consultancy? The answer goes deeper than revenue models or product-market fit — it comes down to the collective spirit at the foundation of High Noon Product.
- [AI: Redemption from the Fall, or the Downfall of Humanity?](https://www.highnoonproduct.com/posts/ai-redemption-or-downfall.html): This post argues that AI, when guided by pro-human ethics and free-market accountability, mirrors three redemptive patterns from scripture: relief from compulsory labor, creation through spoken word, and the redistribution of collective intelligence.
- [Faith & Work](https://www.highnoonproduct.com/posts/faith-and-work.html): We cannot partition our lives between work and faith, especially if we want corporate culture to thrive. Here's the revelatory story behind the name and mission of High Noon Product.
- [Our Vision For The New World](https://www.highnoonproduct.com/posts/vision-new-world.html): At High Noon, we see humanity at a pivotal threshold. Here's our vision for a new era rooted in harmony, abundance, and visionary product leadership that addresses the world's greatest challenges.
